project.name: Rain's Flexible Modules — Farm Worlds
project.description: Somewhere to strip-mine that is thrown away and made again, so the main world is left alone. The worlds themselves are RainsCore's — three linked worlds with their own nether and end, the portal linking between them, the schedule and the one rule that decides what may be deleted. What is here is how somebody gets in: scattered rather than dropped on one spot, warned before the ground under them is thrown away, and waited between trips.
